name: Anastasia Hartwell
summary: Anastasia Hartwell is a prominent Forsaken mage trainer residing in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. She guides fledgling and developing spellcasters in mastering the arcane arts and oversees vital magical research and field missions across Lordaeron and beyond.

sections.title: Arcane Mastery in the Ruins
sections.body: Standing within the dark, echoing chambers of the Undercity's Magic Quarter, Anastasia Hartwell instructs Forsaken and Horde mages in channeling arcane energies. Though the kingdom of Lordaeron fell to ruin, former human practitioners like Anastasia have preserved their scholarly traditions in undeath. She maintains that magic demands strict discipline, warning any traveler she meets that careless incantations will quickly consume the untrained.

sections.title: Field Research and Relics
sections.body: Beyond fundamental spell instruction, Anastasia directs promising students toward vital field investigations. She dispatches mages into Tirisfal Glades, including the blighted grounds of the Balnir Farmstead and ruined alchemist workshops, to recover lost reagents and salvage remnants of forgotten arcane lore. Through her tasks, practitioners learn that securing magical dominance requires braving the hazardous ruins of their former homeland.

sections.title: Allies of the Craft
sections.body: Anastasia's connections reach well beyond the borders of Tirisfal. As Horde spellcasters grow in proficiency, she coordinates with fellow trainers in distant lands, such as Deino in Orgrimmar, and directs advanced students toward solitary masters like Tabetha in the swamplands of Dustwallow Marsh. Her guidance ensures that Forsaken mages remain woven into the wider tapestry of the Horde's magical pursuits.

faq.answer: Anastasia Hartwell is a Forsaken mage trainer located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity. She teaches spells to developing mages and provides specialized assignments to retrieve arcane artifacts and reagents across Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can I find Anastasia Hartwell?
faq.answer: She is located in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, gathered among other arcane practitioners and trainers under the city's vaulted subterranean ceilings.

faq.q: What does Anastasia say to non-mages?
faq.answer: She offers cautious advice to non-mage visitors, warning them to be wary of magic as they journey across the world, noting that it readily burns the untrained.

faq.q: What quests does Anastasia Hartwell offer?
faq.answer: Anastasia offers various training assignments for mages, including investigating the Balnir Farmstead, exploring ruined alchemist shops for supplies, and liaising with distant teachers such as Deino in Orgrimmar and Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.

faq.q: Is Anastasia Hartwell related to other Hartwells in Tirisfal?
faq.answer: She shares a surname with Andrew Hartwell and Geoffrey Hartwell, but their family relationship is unconfirmed.

faq.q: Why does Anastasia send mages to the Balnir Farmstead?
faq.answer: She asks mages to gather Balnir Snapdragons so she can measure the spread of the plague in Tirisfal Glades and send the flowers to the apothecaries.

angles.text: Anastasia Hartwell is an essential mentor for Horde mages passing through the Undercity, training higher spell ranks and commissioning vital class quests.
She represents the continuation of Dalaran and Lordaeron's esteemed arcane traditions among the Forsaken, preserved even through the tragedy of undeath.
Through partnerships with trainers like Deino in Orgrimmar, Anastasia bridges Lordaeron's arcane heritage with the broader magical endeavors of the Horde.
